expectations.text: Clearly states that generated files are overwritten on regeneration
expectations.evidence: Opens with 'Every call to BackendGenerator.generate() overwrites the output files entirely'. Restates 'Don't edit generated files directly as your primary workflow — they will be overwritten'

expectations.text: Recommends creating separate extension/wrapper files that import from generated code
expectations.evidence: Section 2 'Wrapper script (recommended for custom endpoints)' is the headline recommendation, with a layout showing app.py and custom_endpoints.py separate from generated files

expectations.text: Shows a concrete code example of the extension pattern
expectations.evidence: app.py example: 'from main_api import app' followed by @app.get('/custom/stats') and @app.post('/books/{book_id}/validate')

expectations.text: Does NOT recommend editing main_api.py directly as the primary approach
